选择皮肤站，或直接填 Yggdrasil API 地址: Choose a skin server, or enter a Yggdrasil API address directly
选择要安装的构建。可按游戏版本和加载器筛选。: Pick a build to install. Filter by game version and loader.
选择要装进这个世界的数据包: Choose the data packs to install into this world
遇到问题先看帮助，解决不了再提反馈: Check the help first; send feedback if that doesn't solve it
部分模组没能更新: Some mods could not be updated
重启启动器后界面才会变成新语言: Restart the launcher for the new language to take effect
重新校验并补齐「{0}」的依赖库与资源？: Re-verify and restore the libraries and assets of "{0}"?
重新走一遍首次运行的分步设置：目录、下载源、内存、隔离，顺带回顾几个容易错过的功: Redo the first-run setup: directory, download source, memory, isolation, plus a feature recap
锁定后拖动窗口始终保持这个比例，壁纸不会被裁头裁脚: When locked, the window keeps this ratio while resizing so wallpapers are never cropped
问我要下什么、哪报错、模组怎么配… Enter 发送，Shift+Enter: Ask what to download, what failed, how to configure mods…  Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline
陶瓦在后台运行，Windows 不会提示。点「允许访问」后在 UAC 选是。若装: Terracotta runs in the background with no Windows prompt. Click Allow access and choose Yes in UAC. If you use 360 / PC Manager / Huorong, whitelist Terracotta and EasyTier there too.
陶瓦联机暂未提供此架构的官方内核。: No official Terracotta runtime for this architecture yet.
隔多久换下一张: How long before switching to the next one
首次使用需要下载约 8 MB 的官方内核，之后可直接开房。: First use downloads ~8 MB official runtime; then you can host anytime.
默认布局不能删除，可用「重置默认」恢复: The default layout can't be deleted; use “Reset to default”
默认开。Clash 7897 会生效；关掉才强制直连: On by default. Clash 7897 works; turn off to force direct
默认开。关掉才强制直连: On by default. Turn it off to force a direct connection

可以在「下载任务」里查进度。: You can check progress under Download tasks.
它没有真的开始执行：模型只回了文字，没有调用任何工具。: It never actually started: the model only replied with text and never called any tool.

等它说完，或点「停止」再发: Wait for it to finish, or press Stop and send again

点保存后立即对下一轮生效: Takes effect on the next turn after saving
规则可记到全局或当前实例；删除工具不提供始终允许: Rules can be saved globally or for this instance; delete tools cannot be always allowed
限定参数（留空 = 整个工具）: Limit to an argument (empty = entire tool)

检查点不可用，本轮改动无法一键撤回: Checkpoint unavailable; changes in this round cannot be undone

变更过大，仅显示前 {n} 行: Change too large; showing first {n} lines

预计新增文件数：安装时确定（多于 1 个）: Expected new files: determined at install time (more than 1)
回合还在跑，先停止再撤回: A turn is still running; stop it before undoing
